title: Seated Lateral Raise Machine (Elbow Pads)
summary: A seated machine lateral raise with pads on your outer arms, so your grip and traps barely help and the side delts do the lifting.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for side delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.15 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.15 for traps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Sit with the machine pivot lined up with your shoulders and the pads against your outer upper arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, pushing through the pads.
Lower slowly until the weight nearly touches down.

form_cues.cue: Raise the arms out to the sides
Relax your hands. Pushing through your elbows keeps the traps out of it.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable.
Swap sheet: One side at a time, Steadier cable tension.
